text:
Sam: customer on Private (vpc-33) reports intermittent TLS handshake failures after the cert rotation last night. They see "SSL routines:tls_construct_stoc:internal error" on their clients and curl fails with 'certificate verify failed'.

Priya: thanks Sam — which hostname and any recent rotator logs? can the customer share the output of `openssl s_client -connect <host>:443 -showcerts -servername <host>` (no private keys) and the full chain that our rotator uploaded?

Sam: host is api.customer-example.internal (we're proxying via their HAProxy in the VPC). I grabbed the rotator log: `rotator: uploaded bundle size=2048 bytes` and later `rotator: verify OK`. Customer pasted `openssl` output but the chain only shows two certs instead of three (missing intermediate). here's the snippet they sent:

```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.customer-example.internal
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.customer-example.internal
   i:/CN=intermediate.example-ca
 1 s:/CN=intermediate.example-ca
   i:/CN=root-example-ca
---
```

Sam: note the missing cross-signed intermediate (we normally expect a second intermediate between intermediate.example-ca and root-example-ca for this customer's chain).

Alex: hmm, rotator uploaded a bundle but some proxies will trim certs on reload if file has trailing garbage or malformed separators. Do we have the actual PEM file bytes from the bundle? Sam, can you `s3 cp` the bundle to support bucket and share path?

Sam: uploaded to s3://redwood-support/bundles/customer-33/1839923400.pem (shared).

infra-bot: file checksum recorded sha256=9b3f4a... , size=2048, uploaded by rotator-service at 2026-06-12T01:03:20Z

Priya: customer also mentioned their HAProxy config does `crt-list` and calls `haproxy -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg -p /run/haproxy.pid -sf $(cat /run/haproxy.pid)` on deploy. Some versions will try to parse the bundle and drop certs after an unexpected newline. Can we reproduce locally by feeding the bundle into haproxy's crt parsing?

Alex: I pulled the PEM from S3 and inspected it. Looks like our rotator wrote the chain with Windows-style CRLF endings and also a repeated `-----END CERTIFICATE-----\r\n` followed by an extra blank `\r\n`. HAProxy's crt-list parser in 2.2 has a bug where it stops after the first blank line. Repro steps I ran:

```
echo -e "$(cat 1839923400.pem)" > /tmp/test.pem
haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/test.cfg  # cfg references /tmp/test.pem via crt-list
# parsing warnings: dropped certificate(s) in /tmp/test.pem
```

Jordan: ok that explains why the intermediate was missing at the proxy. Customers' clients fail verification because intermediate isn't served. For a hotfix we can ask customer to restart haproxy with the full bundle replaced by a normalized PEM (unix LF) — quick command to normalize:

```
awk 'BEGIN{ORS="\n"} /BEGIN CERTIFICATE/ {print "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----"} /END CERTIFICATE/ {print "-----END CERTIFICATE-----"} /-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----/,/-----END CERTIFICATE-----/ {gsub("\r","",$0); print $0}' 1839923400.pem > /tmp/fixed.pem
```

Sam: supplied the awk fix to customer; they replaced the cert and restarted haproxy and initial handshakes succeeded. But they reported thrashing during reloads earlier — we should prevent a recurrence.

Priya: root cause could be rotator process that concatenates cert files using `printf "%s\n" $(cat certs/*.pem)` which can collapse separators when filenames contain spaces or when cert files already include trailing newlines. Action items: 1) Add PEM normalization step in rotator before upload (convert CRLF to LF, ensure single newline between certs). 2) Add unit test that simulates crt-list parsing on haproxy 2.2 and 2.4. 3) Notify oncall and ops docs.

Alex: I'll open a PR to the rotator repo with a small normalization function (perl -0777 -pe 's/\r\n/\n/g; s/\n+\n/\n\n/g' ) and add CI check to validate bundle has at least N certificate boundaries and no blank lines between certs. Also add a remediation script we can share with customers.

Jordan: also check if the customer's VPC egress allowlist includes our OCSP/CRL endpoints — missing intermediate could trigger OCSP fetches which fail if egress blocked, worsening errors. Sam, can you confirm their SGs/NACLs allow egress to port 80/443 to ocsp.example-ca and crl.example-ca?

Sam: customer confirmed ocsp and crl hosts were reachable. they only saw failures during rollouts when HAProxy parsed the bundle and dropped the certificate. After replacing with normalized PEM, everything looks green.

Priya: perfect. I'll mark this as resolved with root cause 'rotator produced PEM with extra CRLF/blank-line which caused HAProxy crt-list parser to drop intermediate on reload'. I'll file an internal postmortem and tag rotator and eng-runtime. For the customer, propose a change log and the hotfix steps we gave.

Sam: customer happy for now and asked for guidance to add cert-file validation in their deploy pipeline. I've sent them our validation snippet and the remediation script. :white_check_mark:

Alex: PR opened: github.com/redwood/rotator/pull/512 — includes normalization + CI. I'll link PR in the PM notes.
